text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "cards.frameVersion is a 5-value categorical attribute denoting the Magic card frame style (years 1993/1997/2003/2015 plus 'future'), while foreign_data.id is a unique surrogate primary key for foreign-language card entries, so the overlap is merely the chance coincidence of a few year values falling within the 1–229205 ID range (near-zero target coverage, no semantic or name affinity)."}
